sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the Table 4-6 SPARQL constraint: its FILTER currently selects rows satisfying the required thresholds, causing compliant frames to be reported as violations. Select only rows where the applicable ice-class/hull-region comparison fails, including the IA Super bow reachesTankTopOrBelowFloorTop condition, or equivalently negate the complete compliance expression. Also remove the ShipShape sh:hasComponent property constraint to gen:FrameShape: hasComponent targets shipComponent, while the declared framing properties belong directly to frame and are already targeted by FrameTargetShape; this unnecessary component indirection checks the wrong entity.
